rows.sourceEnglish: A soil cross-section shows dark topsoil above pale subsoil, with two worms. Beside it, a jar of soil settles into three layers — sand, silt and clay.
rows.currentTarget: Soil cross-section i sumbedza dark topsoil nga nṱha ha pale subsoil, i na worms mbili. Kha thungo, the soil in the jar settles into three layers — sand, silt na clay.
rows.candidateTarget: Soil cross-section i sumbedza topsoil ya muvhala wa swiswi nga nṱha ha subsoil yo dombileaho, i na worms mbili. Kha thungo, jar ya mavu i sumbedza mavu a tshi dzula a vha layers tharu — sand, silt na clay.
rows.backTranslationBeforeComparison: The section shows dark-coloured topsoil above subsoil described by an unverified pale term, with two worms. Beside it a jar shows soil sitting/becoming three layers.
rows.reason: Exact pale equivalence is unestablished and jar shows soil sitting is less explicit than physical settles. Preserve current first sentence and exact settles into three layers. No colour/settling inference from the still image.
rows.recommendedTarget: Soil cross-section i sumbedza dark topsoil nga nṱha ha pale subsoil, i na worms mbili. Kha thungo, mavu a re kha jar a settles into three layers — sand, silt na clay.

rows.sourceEnglish: Soil contains many kinds of living organisms. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
rows.currentTarget: Mavu a na mifuda minzhi ya living organisms. Bacteria na fungi dzi thusa u break down organic matter na u cycle nutrients.
rows.candidateTarget: Mavu a na mifuda minzhi ya zwithu zwine zwa tshila. Bacteria na fungi dzi thusa u break down organic matter na u cycle nutrients.
rows.backTranslationBeforeComparison: Soil contains many kinds of things that live. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
rows.reason: Living things preserves living organisms in plain framing, no species added. Exact prior955 break down and cycle nutrients remain.
rows.recommendedTarget: Mavu a na mifuda minzhi ya zwithu zwine zwa tshila. Bacteria na fungi dzi thusa u break down organic matter na u cycle nutrients.

rows.sourceEnglish: Compaction, poor drainage and loss of organic matter can limit roots and soil life.

rows.backTranslationBeforeComparison: Compaction, poor drainage and loss of organic matter can reduce the growth of roots and soil life.
rows.reason: Root growth narrows the source broader limit roots. Remove added growth and retain limit as precise English predicate while accepting soil-life framing.
rows.recommendedTarget: Compaction, poor drainage na u xela ha organic matter zwi nga limit midzi na vhutshilo ha mavu.

rows.backTranslationBeforeComparison: Look at things that repeat over the field. Check the history of how the field was managed, drainage and plant growth before choosing a way to solve the problem.
rows.reason: Things repeating narrows patterns, which can include spatial gradients. Retain patterns English while accepting management-history and remedy framing. BEFORE and three checks intact.
rows.recommendedTarget: Sedzani patterns tsimuni yoṱhe. Sedzani ḓivhazwakale ya nḓila ya u langa tsimu, drainage na u aluwa ha zwimela ni sa athu khetha nḓila ya u tandulula thaidzo.
